chapters.title: Chapter 201: Accident and the Special One
paragraphs: The confirmation of the Hunter’s destruction immediately brought joy to everyone. All the Survivors who had joined the fight gained experience points after all.
"We did it!" Mei shouted in joy.
"That thing is tough! Victor would love to dismantle this." Aurora added as she recalled the tireless mechanic in Haven-45.
"Wait... Do you think they’d be able to destroy one of these in Haven-45?" Amer asked worriedly as he reloaded his gun.

"Don’t underestimate Claire... The woman is terrifying. There’s also that large Artillery. Kai also gave them enough weapons. Besides, Sera and Althea were there. They have Gene Weapons. You can’t underestimate them." Aurora said as she recalled how Claire used her Spirit Possession before.
In any case, Mei seemed to have leveled up just now and was already checking out the increase in her stats.
For Kai, the highest‐level Survivor at Level 30, the points didn’t matter much anymore.
He was already at the limit.
But for the others, those points were extremely valuable. Every bit of experience meant growth, strength, and a better chance to survive the next battle.
In any case, since he was able to get the last hit, he was the one given to choose among the possible achievement rewards.
[ You can select one reward: Instant Experience Potion x5, C-Grade Energy Cores x5, Random Gift Pack x5, Survivor Medal x2 ]
Well, Instant Experience Potions weren’t useful to him with his current level. He also has extra Alpha Gene Enhancement Serums that could give him Experience Points if needed.
C-Grade Energy Cores were something he could loot now, even if they were still quite rare.
As for the Gift Pack, he didn’t even glance at it.
Finally, the Survivor Medal... but there were only 2 of them.

It was something he could already obtain from others in exchange for his Gift Packs. Now that he had Superior Gift Packs, he knew that he’d be earning them faster with the help of other Survivors within the two shelters.
There was no need to get them...
In the end, Kai decided to just take more C-Grade Energy Cores with him.
Soon, they also kept the remains of the Hunter Units and stored them in the warehouse for safe dismantling for later.
After everything was settled, they all returned to the building...
Finally, Kai uncorked a spirit‐boosting potion flask and drank it down in one gulp.
Ding!
[ Spirit Points +100 ]
Warm energy rushed through his body, filling him instantly.
He knew the effect would weaken if he drank too many within the same hour, but he didn’t care. He consumed flask after flask until his Spirit Points reached the full 350.
"Good," Kai muttered, flexing his hand as the warmth of Spirit energy pulsed through him.
"I’ll need every bit of this."
The day dragged on, and the event continued.
Drones buzzed overhead, Swarmers tried to enter their building, and their bases were marked... Then, the real threat arrived.
"What?" Kai was shocked to see it...
This time, two Hunters stepped into view.
The survivors froze.
"Two of them?" Amer whispered. "We barely handled one!"
As he said this, the Hunters advanced!
Kai raised his rifle and gave a warning...
"No time to hesitate. Atom, cover us!"
Atom’s plasma rifle hummed as it locked onto the nearest Hunter.
Fwoosh!
Plasma bolts streaked through the air, slamming into the armor. The Hunters stepped back but kept moving!
This time, under Kai’s command, Mei pulled out a strange injector.
[ Gene Stimulant Injector ( Unique Equipment ): Temporarily enhances cellular recovery, stamina, and reflex response... Effects last for at least 10 minutes. Overuse may cause strain. ]
She jabbed it into her arm. "Let’s go!"
Aurora, Amer, and many others followed, injecting themselves carefully.
Soon, their eyes widened as the stimulant surged through their veins.
"Whoa... I feel faster!" Amer gasped, gripping his rifle tighter.
"Don’t overuse it," Kai warned. "Ten minutes only. Make it count."
The battle continued...
Plasma fire from Atom hit the Hunters, while the survivors moved around with enhanced speed, avoiding any attacks from the mechanical tentacles!
Bang! Bang! Bang!
Bullets struck the tentacles, slowing their movements.
Kai then used Specter Step, appearing behind one Hunter. His Spirit Pulse exploded, tearing its cloak apart.
Boom!
Now, he knew where to hit!
He didn’t just release it at any part of the body. It was released to the most vulnerable part of the enemy that he had found in the previous battle!
Just like that, the survivors cheered as the first Hunter collapsed under Atom’s plasma barrage and Kai’s attacks...
Still, the second Hunter caused so much trouble...
It fought harder with its blades slashing wildly, but teamwork won the day.
"Two down!" Mei shouted, panting.
But the relief didn’t last.
Another pair of Hunters arrived.
Aurora cursed. "Again?!"
Kai steadied his rifle. "Stay sharp. Same plan. Atom, keep firing!"
The fight repeated... It was brutal and exhausting.
Plasma bolts burned, Spirit Pulses were used, and stimulants, including the potion, kept the survivors moving.
The Hunters fell, but not easily... Then, another pattern of Drones and Swarmers came...
Needless to say, two more Hunters came...
By now, the survivors were drenched in sweat, their arms aching from constant fire.
Amer groaned. "How many more?"
Kai’s eyes narrowed. "As many as it takes. We won’t fall here."
Atom fired again with its plasma rifle!
Fwoosh! Fwoosh!
Then, the Hunters weren’t able to advance that far as Kai struck them with another Spirit Pulse, blasting one apart. The other was then finished by Mei’s close-range shots to its tentacles.
Finally, silence.
The survivors collapsed against the walls, breathing hard.
Mei wiped her forehead. "That’s... four batches... in one day. No... The day hasn’t ended yet."
Aurora nodded grimly. "And it’s only the first day of the event."
Kai looked at them all. "Rest for now. Night is coming."
As the sun dipped below the ruins, darkness spread across the shelter...
The weaker drones and swarmers stopped coming, but new enemies emerged!
From the shadows, twenty mechanical hounds appeared.
"Shit... Wait... Twenty hounds?!" Mei was shocked as she heard the news...
However, as she looked at Kai, she realized that he was frozen...
"No, don’t tell me..." Mei’s eyes widened as she recalled the enemy composition in this event according to the system notification.
[ Estimated Enemy Composition: Swarmer, Hounds, Hunters, and a special one. ]

chapters.title: Chapter 202: The Special One
paragraphs: From the shadows, twenty mechanical hounds appeared. They had red eyes at the moment, and it could probably allow them to see at night...
Still, they were all surprised to see so many of them at once.
However, they weren’t their only problem.
Soon, they noticed Kai was looking above, frozen...
Everyone felt nervous as they followed Kai’s gaze.
"This..."
"Oh, no..."
At first, they thought it was just more swarmers. But then, above the pack, something else could be seen...
A mechanical unit hovered silently in the air.
It wasn’t another humanoid unit or floating units like Dragoons...
It was large, it was a little bit larger than the Impulse gunship they had seen and taken down before.
Its body was circular, smooth, and alien‐like!
Indeed, it was floating without rotors like Impulse...
Instead, it seemed to use anti‐gravity or some advanced floatation device. The sight alone made the survivors shiver.
Aurora whispered, "That... that’s not Aria’s design for sure."
Kai agreed. He had also been classifying their enemies whether they were Aria’s or Anima’s creations.
"You’re right. This is Anima’s work."
Aria, the human‐made A.I., had only ever produced D‐Grade and E‐Grade units powered by batteries as far as they knew.
But this floating disk was something else entirely. It was definitely powered by advanced Energy Cores, far beyond Aria’s reach.
The survivors stared as the disk hovered silently, no cannons or guns visible.
It looked almost harmless. But then, hatches opened beneath its belly.
Kai’s eyes widened. "It’s deploying..."
Drones or probably Swarmers poured out!
"Ready!" Mei immediately said as they raised their guns.
The Hounds below could be temporarily blocked by the wall and traps, but these drones are flying...
"No way..." Kai muttered as he noticed something.
It seemed that these weren’t the same weak drones they had fought before. Their bodies were bulkier, and they seemed to be a little bit slower... As if they were carrying something heavy...
Atom’s sensors also beeped, and Kai knew that a threat had been detected!
Kai barked, "Atom, shoot one down!"
The A‐Grade Sentinel raised its rifle and fired.
Bang!
The bullet struck a Swarmer mid‐air. But instead of just malfunctioning before going down, something unexpected happened.
Boom!
An explosion occurred! The Swarmer was broken down!
Mei gasped. "Wait... that wasn’t normal!"
Kai’s heart sank. "Bombers..."
The swarmers weren’t just drones anymore. They were living bombs.
Aurora’s face went pale. "If they reach the wall..."
Kai immediately turned to his team and gave a command instantly. "Ignore the hounds! The wall will hold them for now. Focus on the bombers!"
The survivors shifted their aim, and rifles were soon triggered as they fired into the sky.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
One bomber exploded before it could land, showering debris across the courtyard. Another slammed into the ground near the barricade, detonating with a deafening blast.
Boom!
The shockwave knocked two survivors off their feet.
Amer shouted, "They’re going to tear the shelter apart!"
Kai moved with Specter Step, appearing in front of three Bombers!
Soon, his hand glowed with Spirit energy.
"Spirit Pulse!"
Boom!
The controlled burst of energy blasted and threw the three bombers away!
Thanks to that, Kai detonated them from a distance!
Aurora fired her rifle, and thankfully, her bullets would hit another bomber’s weak spot. It exploded mid‐air, lighting up the night sky.

Mei also moved to a different position since if they were too close to the shelter, the bombers would be able to create more damage... After all, bringing them down wouldn’t stop the bombs from exploding!
She used her guns and even her knives and axe to ensure that the moving Bombers were quickly dealt with...
After all, she wasn’t an expert shooter. Even if she was able to hit the bombers, some of the bullets weren’t even able to hit the explosives, and they’d continue moving...
Kai shouted, "Keep them away from the walls! Atom, suppress the disk!"
Atom switched its weapon and this time, it raised its plasma rifle, firing volley after volley at the hovering unit.
Plasma bolts slammed into its circular body, but the disk barely flinched.
Its anti‐gravity field, or whatever technology it was, activated, deflecting most of the damage.
Aurora cursed after seeing that their strongest weapon, the Plasma Rifle, wasn’t working!
"It’s too strong!"
Kai also realized this. Still, he was thankful that the disk-shaped vessel wasn’t attacking with plasma guns or laser guns at all...
"Then we take out the bombers first. That thing is probably just a carrier. If we stop its payload, we stop the destruction."
Just like that, the survivors fought desperately. They weren’t the best shooters out there, but with so many of them firing at the same time, they were able to hit them...
Furthermore, their bodies could endure the recoil thanks to the stimulant they injected into themselves!
Drugging themselves may not be the best method, but for now, it was needed!
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Bombers exploded one after another, lighting up the shelter with fire and smoke.
But the disk kept releasing more.
Amer groaned. "It’s endless!"
Kai clenched his fists. "Let’s just endure... Mei, lead a small team to deal with the Hounds below! They’ll be able to climb up soon."
"Got it!" Mei replied.
At the same time, another bomber dove toward the barricade.
Atom fired this time with its plasma bolt striking it mid‐air.
Boom!
The explosion shook the wall, but it held.
Aurora shouted, "Kai! We can’t keep this up forever!"
Kai knew that very well, so he used his Specter Step and this time, he appeared beneath the hovering disk.
Since it was not using any attacks on them and was only releasing the bombers! He felt more confident to do this dangerous move!
Soon, spirit energy surged through his body.
He raised his hand, aiming at the underside of the carrier.
"Spirit Pulse!"
[ Gene Skill Activated: Spirit Pulse ]
Spirit Points: -70
Boom!
The blast struck the disk’s force field or barrier, and for the first time, the carrier wobbled! It was as if its anti‐gravity tech had malfunctioned!

chapters.title: Chapter 203: The Vessel and the Status Check
paragraphs: Mei’s eyes lit up as she saw what had just happened... "You hurt it!"
Kai gritted his teeth as he landed on the ground.
"Not enough. Atom, focus fire on the weak spot!"
Atom locked onto the damaged section and unleashed a barrage of plasma bolts.
Fwoosh! Fwoosh! Fwoosh!
The disk vessel shuddered as it was hit by the attacks... Still, the vessel remained floating...
Aurora fired her rifle, adding to the assault. Amer and the others followed, with their bullets crashing into the weakened forcefield or barrier that it was using...
Finally, with a loud crack, the disk’s shield collapsed!
Kai shouted, "Now! Finish it!"
Atom fired one last plasma burst and this time, it passed through the vessel’s frame!
Boom!
The disk exploded in the air with flames engulfing its circular body.
Debris rained down, crushing several hounds beneath it.
Apparently, they seemed to have destroyed the remaining Bombers inside as well!
The survivors cheered, relief flooding through them.
But Kai didn’t smile.
He stared at the burning wreckage... This wasn’t the end of the event yet. They would be facing more of them soon!
After all, the Surveillance Sweep Event would last for 7 days, and this was only the first day of the event.
Soon, the others also realized that.
What if there were three or five more of them? It could be disastrous.
Aurora swallowed hard. "If that was terrifying for sure."
Mei looked at the survivors.
"If more of those carriers come... Freedom Shelter won’t survive."
Kai agreed. He was aware of it.
"Then we’ll grow stronger. Whatever Anima sends, we’ll fight it..."
Then, he finally looked at the notifications he had ignored for a while.
[ You have discovered Special Carrier: "Dominion" ]
[ Grade: Advanced War Machine ]
[ Status: Destroyed ]
[ Description: A circular, anti‐gravity carrier designed for aerial deployment. Equipped with advanced floatation technology and internal hatches that release modified Swarmer Bombers. ]
"It’s called Dominion, huh..." Kai muttered.
After this confirmation, he saw the notifications he really wanted to see.
[ Enemy Unit Destroyed: Dominion (C) ]
[ Experience Points distributed among all participants. ]
[ +1500 Experience Points ]
[ Congratulations! You are the first Survivor to eliminate a Dominion Unit. ]
[ Hint: Only the first elimination of each C-Grade and higher unit can provide special rewards! ]
[ You have received: Reputation Points +10 ]
[ You can select one reward: Random Enhanced Gift Pack x3, C‐Grade Energy Core x15, Survivor Medal x5 ]
Kai frowned...

The five Survivor Medals were very important. However, the 15 C-Grade Energy Cores could also help them a lot. After all, aside from being used to be converted into Plasma Charge, they’re also a precious item that low-level Survivors could use to absorb and get stronger.
In the end, Kai selected the cores!

Kai clenched his fist as the notification faded. The fifteen C‐Grade Energy Cores were already stored safely in his inventory. They would be invaluable for both plasma charges and for helping lower‐level Survivors grow stronger.
But before he could speak, Kai noticed Atom moving.
The android walked steadily toward the burning wreckage of the Dominion.
Its glowing eyes were fixed on the shattered remains of the cockpit.
Kai was curious as he recalled something similar.
Well, he had seen this before, when Atom approached the Impulse wreckage. Back then, he had stopped it since he knew what it would do.
This time, however, he chose not to interfere.
’Let’s see how you’ll do it,’Kai thought.
Atom reached the Dominion’s remains and extended its hand. From the twisted metal, it pulled out a black sphere... It was a strange core that seemed just like any other metal ball.
Aurora gasped. "What is that?"
This was her first time seeing this. She couldn’t understand why Atom would want that.
Mei’s eyes widened. "It looks... normal."
Well, she thought that Atom would take something awesome.
She then looked at Kai to ask questions, but noticed that he seemed to be looking forward to something.
She turned her gaze back to the A-Grade Sentinel and saw something shocking...
Without hesitation, Atom pressed the sphere against its chest.
The black ball seemed to dissolve, merging into the android’s frame.
Kai smiled...
"So it’s absorbing that thing..."
The survivors watched in silence as Atom’s glowing eyes seemed to have become brighter.
Amer muttered, "It’s... charging itself?"
Kai nodded slowly. He could feel it... Atom was fully powered again.
Whatever that black sphere was, it had restored the android completely.
Aurora whispered, "So that’s why it went to the wreckage. It knew there was something inside."
Kai nodded. "I’m guessing it’s something only A-Grade like Atom could use."
The survivors gently nodded.
Mei asked, "Is that safe? What if it changes Atom?"
Kai didn’t answer immediately. He simply watched the android with its fresh energy.
Finally, Kai spoke.
"Safe or not... Atom is stronger. And right now, we need that strength."
The survivors fell silent and nodded.
If that black ball helps Atom, then that would be great news.
Kai turned his gaze back to the battlefield. The Dominion was gone, but the event was far from over. This was only the first day.
More Hunters, more Hounds, and perhaps more "Special Units" would come.
But now, Atom was fully charged again.
Kai clenched his fists...
"Whatever comes next... we’ll be ready."
Soon, everyone retreated to the main building.
Aside from the basement, no lights were used on the ground floor or the first floor. Darkness was their shield now.
The survivors were exhausted, so only two workers remained on the ground floor, tasked with monitoring the drones and swarmers in case more appeared.
After cleaning themselves, Amer, their only cook in the shelter, moved quietly among them.
He served them hot meals. They were mostly MREs, but with added vegetables they had stored earlier. The warmth of the food brought a small comfort, and it also eased the tension after a long battle.
After the meal, Amer approached Kai, who was seated near the wall...
"Can I ask for another Status check?" Amer asked carefully.
Kai looked up as he didn’t expect the question.
"You want to see how much we’ve grown today? That’s a good idea..."

sentences.text: Mei’s eyes lit up as she saw what had just happened...
"You hurt it!"
Kai gritted his teeth as he landed on the ground.
"Not enough.
Atom, focus fire on the weak spot!"
Atom locked onto the damaged section and unleashed a barrage of plasma bolts.
Fwoosh!
Fwoosh!
Fwoosh!
The disk vessel shuddered as it was hit by the attacks...
Still, the vessel remained floating...
Aurora fired her rifle, adding to the assault.
Amer and the others followed, with their bullets crashing into the weakened forcefield or barrier that it was using...
Finally, with a loud crack, the disk’s shield collapsed!
Kai shouted, "Now!
Finish it!"
Atom fired one last plasma burst and this time, it passed through the vessel’s frame!
Boom!
The disk exploded in the air with flames engulfing its circular body.
Debris rained down, crushing several hounds beneath it.
Apparently, they seemed to have destroyed the remaining Bombers inside as well!
The survivors cheered, relief flooding through them.
But Kai didn’t smile.
He stared at the burning wreckage...
This wasn’t the end of the event yet.
They would be facing more of them soon!
After all, the Surveillance Sweep Event would last for 7 days, and this was only the first day of the event.
Soon, the others also realized that.
What if there were three or five more of them?
It could be disastrous.
Aurora swallowed hard.
"If that was terrifying for sure."
Mei looked at the survivors.
"If more of those carriers come...
Freedom Shelter won’t survive."
Kai agreed.
He was aware of it.
"Then we’ll grow stronger.
Whatever Anima sends, we’ll fight it..."
Then, he finally looked at the notifications he had ignored for a while.
[ You have discovered Special Carrier: "Dominion" ]
[ Grade: Advanced War Machine ]
[ Status: Destroyed ]
[ Description: A circular, anti‐gravity carrier designed for aerial deployment.
Equipped with advanced floatation technology and internal hatches that release modified Swarmer Bombers. ]
"It’s called Dominion, huh..." Kai muttered.
After this confirmation, he saw the notifications he really wanted to see.
[ Enemy Unit Destroyed: Dominion (C) ]
[ Experience Points distributed among all participants. ]
[ +1500 Experience Points ]
[ Congratulations!
You are the first Survivor to eliminate a Dominion Unit. ]
[ Hint: Only the first elimination of each C-Grade and higher unit can provide special rewards! ]
[ You have received: Reputation Points +10 ]
[ You can select one reward: Random Enhanced Gift Pack x3, C‐Grade Energy Core x15, Survivor Medal x5 ]
Kai frowned...
The five Survivor Medals were very important.
However, the 15 C-Grade Energy Cores could also help them a lot.
After all, aside from being used to be converted into Plasma Charge, they’re also a precious item that low-level Survivors could use to absorb and get stronger.
In the end, Kai selected the cores!
Kai clenched his fist as the notification faded.
The fifteen C‐Grade Energy Cores were already stored safely in his inventory.
They would be invaluable for both plasma charges and for helping lower‐level Survivors grow stronger.
But before he could speak, Kai noticed Atom moving.
The android walked steadily toward the burning wreckage of the Dominion.
Its glowing eyes were fixed on the shattered remains of the cockpit.
Kai was curious as he recalled something similar.
Well, he had seen this before, when Atom approached the Impulse wreckage.
Back then, he had stopped it since he knew what it would do.
This time, however, he chose not to interfere.
’Let’s see how you’ll do it,’Kai thought.
Atom reached the Dominion’s remains and extended its hand.
From the twisted metal, it pulled out a black sphere...
It was a strange core that seemed just like any other metal ball.
Aurora gasped.
"What is that?"
This was her first time seeing this.
She couldn’t understand why Atom would want that.
Mei’s eyes widened.
"It looks... normal."
Well, she thought that Atom would take something awesome.
She then looked at Kai to ask questions, but noticed that he seemed to be looking forward to something.
She turned her gaze back to the A-Grade Sentinel and saw something shocking...
Without hesitation, Atom pressed the sphere against its chest.
The black ball seemed to dissolve, merging into the android’s frame.
Kai smiled...
"So it’s absorbing that thing..."
The survivors watched in silence as Atom’s glowing eyes seemed to have become brighter.
Amer muttered, "It’s... charging itself?"
Kai nodded slowly.
He could feel it...
Atom was fully powered again.
Whatever that black sphere was, it had restored the android completely.

It knew there was something inside."

"I’m guessing it’s something only A-Grade like Atom could use."

chapters.title: Chapter 204: The Worker’s Skills
paragraphs: Kai took out the Status Crystal he purchased from the Gene Trader. The last time he had checked Amer was when he was only Level 4.

However, after getting Alpha Gene Enhancement Serum and absorbing a C-Grade Core before, Amer’s level should’ve been at least Level 7 or 8. Now, with Amer’s participation, it wouldn’t be surprising if he were already a higher-level Survivor.

[ Status Crystal: A rare crystal that reveals the complete status of the person who touches it. When activated, it displays their name, title, level, skills, and stats for exactly 10 seconds before fading.
Cooldown: After use, the crystal requires 30 seconds before it can be activated again.
Charge: 18 ]

[ Recharge Requirement: Once its charges reach zero, or even before that point, the crystal must be replenished by pouring Spirit Energy into it. Without this infusion, the crystal will remain dormant and unusable. ]
"Alright... Put your hands on it." Kai said as he showed the small crystal...
"Thank you!" Amer said with a smile as he put his hands on top of it, and soon, his status was analyzed, and a window containing his information appeared for everyone to see.
[ Name: Amer ]
[ Title: None ]
[ Level: 10 ]
[ Physique Rating: D- ]
[ Active Skills: None ]
[ Passive Skills: Spirit Sense Lv0, Dexterity Flow Lv0 ]
"I have two passive skills?" Amer’s eyes widened. He didn’t expect this at all.
However, as he thought about it, he realized that there were indeed times when, if he focused, he could sense everything in his surroundings.
"I think I can check the skills’ description... Wait." Kai said as he manipulated the Crystal and gave a quick look at the two skills.
[ Spirit Sense (Level 0): Heightens awareness through spirit energy, detecting subtle movements and threats. It gives a minor boost to reaction speed. ]
[ Dexterity Flow (Level 0): Enhances coordination, improving agility and precision. It improves evasion chance. ]
"Ohh! This looks nice!" Amer said. Just like that, the time limit passed and the notification finally vanished.
However, Amer had already seen it.

"That’s amazing... The Spirit Sense and the Dexterity Flow will help you a lot. Right, this Global Event will take several days, so make sure to participate and get more experience points." Kai reminded.
Furthermore, deep inside, Kai was actually shocked by the amount of his Spirit Points!
The 185 points were huge! Amer was comparable to someone who had drunk several Gene Enhancement Serums!
However, Amer didn’t know it yet.
"I will participate in all battles!" Amer was now excited. Without a doubt, he would work even harder in hopes of leveling up his skills.
Furthermore, he wanted to reach a higher level to become even more useful.

After all, he was able to get food almost for free. He was also not worrying about the shelter, the drinks, the weapons, and other things. It was all thanks to Kai’s support. With all of this given to him, he really wants to pay Kai back and support him in his battles.
Soon, the other locals who didn’t have a system interface of their own, curiously asked if they could also use the Status Crystal.
Kai thought for a moment. Since there weren’t any significant attacks yet, he nodded.
"It hasn’t been long since you last checked, so the changes shouldn’t be that big yet. But... go ahead. Three of you can try."
The workers exchanged glances, and three stepped forward nervously. One by one, they placed their hands on the crystal.
The first window appeared:
[ Name: Rolan ]
[ Title: None ]
[ Level: 6 ]
[ Spirit: 35 / 35 ]
[ Physique Rating: E ]
[ Active Skills: None ]
[ Passive Skills: Enhanced Stomach Lv1 ]
[ Enhanced Stomach (Level 1): Grants resistance to spoiled food and minor toxins. Slightly reduces hunger effects. ]
Rolan blinked in surprise. "So my skill leveled up! I knew it, I just kept eating random things... It helped a lot."
Kai recalled this man before and smiled at him. He had no idea how useful it was since Jonas had a better stomach. In any case, he encouraged him to work hard.
His purpose may be unknown for now, but he believed that they’d be useful someday.
The second worker stepped forward...
[ Name: Demy ]
[ Title: None ]
[ Level: 6 ]
[ Physique Rating: E- ]
[ Active Skills: None ]
[ Passive Skills: Desert Endurance Lv0 ]
[ Desert Endurance (Level 0): Increases tolerance to dehydration and fatigue. Slightly reduces stamina loss when food or water is scarce. ]
This skill explained how she managed to survive those days as a slave without water.
Demy smiled faintly. The Skill didn’t level up but it was alright.
Finally, the third worker touched the crystal.
[ Name: Tomas ]
[ Title: None ]
[ Level: 5 ]
[ Spirit: 90 / 90 ]
[ Physique Rating: E ]
[ Active Skills: None ]
[ Passive Skills: Iron Skin Lv0 ]
[ Iron Skin (Level 0): Toughens the body’s surface, granting minor resistance to cuts, bruises, and blunt force. Slightly reduces damage taken from physical attacks. ]
Everyone was surprised to see this skill...
When Tomas was checked before, he was only Level 4. Now, after reaching Level 5, he actually obtained an incredible passive skill!
"So that’s why I feel really good during training. My Iron Skin makes me tougher."
The survivors murmured among themselves, impressed by what they had just seen...
Then Tomas turned to Kai, as he felt a little curious, "What do you think the limit of this skill is? Can I block bullets?"
Kai chuckled, shaking his head. "Don’t try that yet. Maybe start with blades first. See how much punishment your skin can take before you start thinking about bullets."
Tomas laughed awkwardly, scratching the back of his head. "Fair enough. I’ll test it carefully later."
"Good..." Kai nodded.
This passive skill could definitely help him protect this shelter.
Kai then noticed something and addressed everyone.

"These are foundations. They may look small now, but they matter. With more battles and more experience, they’ll grow stronger... For now, we need to get ready. We have a visitor outside." He reminded.
The workers straightened as they immediately turned to see what was going on outside!
Kai smiled and turned to everyone... "Alright... This time, I want the front liners to equip the Steelbreakers. We might have to fight in close range."

chapters.title: Chapter 205: The New Enemies
paragraphs: Kai had brought back twenty Steelbreaker Swords from Haven‐45.
They were weapons that worked surprisingly well against the mechanical army despite being blades.
For some reason, they carried an additional effect similar to steel bats... They had crushing power hidden within them, and against machines, that force was invaluable.
Now, outside the shelter walls, the threat had arrived.
The ground trembled as fifty mechanical Hounds scrambled up the barricades...
The fifty of them weren’t a small matter...
Their metal claws could easily tear through their shelter’s crudely made barriers.
They were also strong enough to crush the bones of unlucky Survivors if they allowed themselves to get beaten...
"Front liners, move!" Kai ordered.
The workers who had been given Steelbreakers rushed forward, gripping the heavy swords with both hands.
Behind them, ten others raised their carbines, ready to provide covering fire.
Mei, Aurora, and Amer stood among the fighters...
They were determined to increase their experience points!
Kai, however, remained at the rear.
He had already decided that this battle would be theirs.
Every kill would go to them, so their experience points would rise faster.
Soon, the first Hound leapt over the wall, and it immediately started attacking or biting the nearest person...
"Let’s try this now!"
The Steelbreaker swung with a powerful force, smashing into the creature’s side.
Bam!
Instead of slicing, the blade’s hidden force crushed the Hound’s frame, sending sparks flying as it collapsed!
"Whoa..."
"That’s strong!"
"Steelbreaker it is!"
"Good! Keep hitting them hard!" Aurora shouted, firing her rifle.
Her bullets pierced through another Hound’s leg, slowing it down before a Steelbreaker finished the job.
Mei, however, dashed forward as she wanted to test the Steelbreaker and learn whether it would actually hurt or not...
Soon, she struck a Hound across the head!
Bam!
The force from the move made her almost release the sword as it felt like it stung his hands. Nonetheless, the Steelbreaker’s crushing effect dented its skull until the machine fell limp.
She didn’t stop... another came at her, and she turned, slamming the blade into its chest.
Amer, though less experienced, fought with surprising focus.

His Spirit Sense was now fully in use... It was warning him of a Hound rushing from his blind side. He turned just in time, swinging his Steelbreaker upward. The blade connected, shattering the Hound’s jaw before it could bite.
"This Steelbreaker Sword is just too good."
Kai watched silently, as he slowly scanned the battlefield.
The survivors were scrambling, but they were holding their ground. The Steelbreakers were proving their worth.
The carbines were also being used, peppering the Hounds with suppressive fire.
Each shot weakened the machines, making it easier for the front liners to finish them off.
Still, the Hounds were not stopping...
More climbed over the wall with their claws digging into the barricades.
One worker was knocked down and a Hound went for his throat... but Aurora’s bullet struck it perfectly, piercing its eye.
The machine collapsed before it could finish the attack.
"Stay together!" Kai called out. "Don’t let them isolate you!"
The survivors tightened their formation, fighting back‐to‐back. Steelbreakers were continuously swinging in heavy arcs, crushing frames and snapping joints that they could hit.
Then, to ensure that they would not get overwhelmed, the carbines fired in bursts, keeping the pressure constant.
[ Enemy Unit Destroyed: Hounds (D) ]
[ Experience Points distributed among all participants. ]
[ +200 Experience Points ]
Soon, even Mei’s blade smashed into another Hound, and the damaged circuitry created sparks everywhere!
Still, its body crumpled. She breathed heavily as her sweat dripped down her brow. It seemed like it was a dangerous move, but her eyes were focused...
Meanwhile, Aurora reloaded quickly, as she made sure that she had enough ammunition around her.
After this, she fired again, taking down another Hound that tried to flank them.
At the same time, Amer’s Spirit Sense noticed something...
He looked up just in time to see a Hound leaping over the barricade. He swung his Steelbreaker upward, catching it mid‐air. The crushing force shattered its chest, sending it crashing to the ground.
Thud!
’They’re moving faster and faster... They’re adapting a bit too well. This has to be patched...’
The battle raged on. The survivors fought desperately, but their teamwork held.
One by one, the Hounds fell. Their mechanical bodies littered the ground...
Kai remained at the back as he calmed himself.
He could have joined in, but this was their fight. Every kill meant more experience points for Mei, Aurora, Amer, and the others. They needed this growth.
Finally, after what felt like an eternity, the last Hound was struck down. Its body collapsed with a metallic thud, and silence fell over the battlefield.
"We’ve done it!"
"Heck yeah!"
"We defeated those things... Incredible."
The survivors panted heavily as they all couldn’t help but thank Kai, who wasn’t too far...
The Steelbreakers were dented, but they had held strong thanks to his support.
Aurora lowered her rifle... "I hope there’s another enemy. That’s... fifty down."
Mei wiped her forehead, her grip still tight on the Steelbreaker. "We did it."
Amer looked at Kai and thanked him silently...
Kai nodded slowly as he was only doing what he had to do.
"Good work. Every one of you fought hard."
The survivors exchanged tired smiles.
Kai turned his gaze toward the horizon. The night was far from over. More enemies would come. But for now, the shelter stood, and his people had proven themselves.
"Rest for now," he said firmly. "Tomorrow, we’ll face whatever comes next."
The survivors nodded, as they all felt relieved with how they had managed to survive so far...
They had endured, and they had won all their battles... They were at least confident that they could survive until the end of the Global Event.
Two days passed. The survivors had barely recovered from the relentless waves of Swarmers, Drones, Hounds, and Hunters...
But the night sky looked eerie again.
"Hmm?"
Kai was the first to notice the faint hum... It was a vibration that grew louder, heavier, until the ground itself seemed to vibrate.
He stepped outside, and his eyes went wide!
There it was.
The disk‐shaped vessel, Dominion, had come!
Furthermore, it wasn’t alone this time!
Two Aerial Gunships or the Impulse vessels flanked it like escorts!

The survivors fought desperately, but their teamwork held.
One by one, the Hounds fell.
Their mechanical bodies littered the ground...
Kai remained at the back as he calmed himself.
He could have joined in, but this was their fight.
Every kill meant more experience points for Mei, Aurora, Amer, and the others.
They needed this growth.
Finally, after what felt like an eternity, the last Hound was struck down.
Its body collapsed with a metallic thud, and silence fell over the battlefield.
"We’ve done it!"
"Heck yeah!"
"We defeated those things...
Incredible."
The survivors panted heavily as they all couldn’t help but thank Kai, who wasn’t too far...
The Steelbreakers were dented, but they had held strong thanks to his support.
Aurora lowered her rifle...
"I hope there’s another enemy.
That’s... fifty down."
Mei wiped her forehead, her grip still tight on the Steelbreaker.
"We did it."
Amer looked at Kai and thanked him silently...
Kai nodded slowly as he was only doing what he had to do.
"Good work.
Every one of you fought hard."
The survivors exchanged tired smiles.
Kai turned his gaze toward the horizon.
The night was far from over.
More enemies would come.
But for now, the shelter stood, and his people had proven themselves.
"Rest for now," he said firmly.
"Tomorrow, we’ll face whatever comes next."
The survivors nodded, as they all felt relieved with how they had managed to survive so far...
They had endured, and they had won all their battles...
They were at least confident that they could survive until the end of the Global Event.
Two days passed.
The survivors had barely recovered from the relentless waves of Swarmers, Drones, Hounds, and Hunters...
But the night sky looked eerie again.
"Hmm?"
Kai was the first to notice the faint hum...
It was a vibration that grew louder, heavier, until the ground itself seemed to vibrate.
He stepped outside, and his eyes went wide!
There it was.
The disk‐shaped vessel, Dominion, had come!
Furthermore, it wasn’t alone this time!
Two Aerial Gunships or the Impulse vessels flanked it like escorts!

chapters.title: Chapter 206: The Arrival of the Augmented
paragraphs: The disk-shaped vessel or the Dominion hovered above...
Its circular body even seemed like it was faintly glowing because of the moonlight.
But this time, it wasn’t alone. Two Impulse gunships flanked it, their engines roaring like thunder.
Kai frowned as he felt something was off...
After all, there weren’t any more Swarmers or Drones that came to check on them.
’This is cheating... The system didn’t mention the Impulse being here as well.’Kai muttered, but he couldn’t really do anything about it but complain.
He remembered the last Impulse they had faced, and it had carried Sentinels.
This time, however, the hatches beneath the gunships opened, and mechanical Hounds poured out!
Twenty from the left Impulse. Twenty from the right.
Forty in total, descending like a storm.
"Steelbreakers forward!" Kai commanded. "Carbines, suppress the drop zones!"
The survivors scrambled into formation. The front liners gripped their Steelbreaker Swords, while the ten riflemen raised their carbines and fired at the descending Hounds.
Thud! Thud! Thud!
The bullets weren’t enough to penetrate the armor of the Hounds, but it was doing well suppressing them.
Furthermore, if they got lucky, they’d hit the scanners and joints of the Hounds that were a lot softer compared to their armor. Thanks to that, it was slowing their advance but not stopping them.
As the Hounds charged, Kai was worried that they would receive some enhancements, like a new weapon or combat patterns.
After all, it would normally be expected when fighting against A.I. Units.
However, it seemed that these low-grade Hounds weren’t even connected to Anima. They seemed to be running in autonomous mode, and they were falling into the same traps.
"Alright! They’re close! Stop firing!" Mei said as she dashed forward...
Her Steelbreaker swung fast!
Bam!
The crushing force dented a Hound’s skull, sending it to the back.
’Tsk... Am I getting tired already?’
Mei frowned at the thought.
She then turned quickly, striking another across the chest... Since her strength wasn’t enough for a one-hit kill, she compensated with her speed.
She was moving so swiftly as if she had an eye at the back of her head.
Aurora fired her rifle in bursts, targeting the Hounds that tried to flank the formation. Each shot weakened their balance, allowing the Steelbreaker Squad to finish them off.
"They’re already getting used to it..." Kai muttered to himself as he saw how everyone was fighting so well.
He didn’t even have to act as they easily dismantled the Hounds and stopped their momentum.
He just remained at the rear, watching carefully. However, as soon as the Dominion made its move, Kai immediately acted.
After all, he was the best person to deal with the Bombers.
With his Specter Step and Spirit Pulse, he’d be able to detonate the bombs before they could reach their target.
Meanwhile, the Impulses started their offensive.
Plasma bolts streaked down, scorching the barricades.
The survivors ducked for cover, but they had already expected this.
"Hold the line! Focus on the Hounds first!"
"Yes! Atom will suppress the vessels above!"
Just like that, Atom acted, and the Steelbreaker Squad swung again and again, crushing the Hounds before.
The carbines also fired in bursts, showering the battlefield with suppressive fire.
With so many enemies being eliminated, the others couldn’t help but celebrate after feeling a familiar sensation.
"I think I leveled up just now!"
"Haha! It feels so good! I’m sure I also reached Level 6!"
Indeed, during this time, everyone was gaining Experience Points!
[ Enemy Unit Destroyed: Hounds (D) ]
[ Experience Points distributed among all participants. ]
[ +200 Experience Points ]
The notifications flashed continuously, but the battle was far from over.
Aurora reloaded quickly...
She fired again, taking down a Hound that pounced on a worker.
"Keep pushing!" she shouted.
Mei’s blade smashed into another Hound...
She breathed heavily, sweat dripping down her brow, but she knew that she couldn’t just rest yet.
At this time, Amer’s Spirit Sense was triggered...
He looked up just in time to see another wave of Hounds leaping from the Impulse hatches. "Incoming!" he warned.
The survivors braced themselves as twenty more mechanical dogs hit the ground.
Kai knew that he had to help them now...
"Second wave!"
Just like that, the survivors fought desperately, but their teamwork held.
’It’s a good thing I prepared many extra magazines, and we added more traps for these Hounds.’Kai mused as he destroyed all the bombers in the air...
At this time, he couldn’t imagine how the other shelters would actually fare against this level of assault.
After all, if not for his infinite gift pack, they wouldn’t have enough firepower to deal with these enemies. They were also very lucky with Atom’s presence on their side.
’There might be a lot of casualties in this event...’
Well, there were probably a lot of names that would definitely disappear in the World Chat after this.
Finally, after what felt like an eternity, the last Hound was struck down. Its body collapsed with a metallic thud, and silence fell over the battlefield once more.
The survivors panted heavily...
"Urgh... When will this end?"
"It’s tiring..."
"Hey! This isn’t over yet!"
"Drink the potions if needed!"
They had faced so many mechanical Hounds and lived. However, the two Impulse Vessels and the Dominion Vessel weren’t eliminated just yet...

The survivors braced themselves, ready to turn their focus on the three vessels hovering above. Soon, the Dominion’s hatches glowed ominously, and the Impulses circled in the sky, preparing for another strike.
Then, without warning, a projectile streaked across the sky. It moved faster than any carbine round, faster than any plasma bolt!
In an instant, it pierced through the air and struck the engines of all three vessels.
Boom!
The Dominion shuddered violently, its anti‐gravity field collapsed instantly!
As if the barrier wasn’t there at all!
The two Impulses also spun out of control with flames trailing from their rotors.
One by one, the massive machines crashed to the ground!
Boom! Boom!
Kai’s eyes widened. He turned sharply toward the source of the shot.
Standing not too far from their shelter was a muscular man in his thirties, clad in striking clothes that Kai recognized immediately.
They were similar to the uniforms he had seen before... the mark of Augmented Humans!
This man was no ordinary survivor. He was definitely an Augmented Human...
Then Kai noticed something that made him stunned.
’Wait... did he just throw those stones?’

chapters.title: Chapter 207: The Target
paragraphs: The battlefield was littered with the wreckage of Dominion, the two Impulses, and the Hounds that the Freedom Shelter destroyed.
As for the three flying vessels on the ground, they were still smoking where they had crashed.
The survivors stared in disbelief at the muscular man below. He seemed completely unbothered, as if destroying three flying vessels with nothing but stones was the most natural thing in the world.
Then his gaze shifted.
The man turned toward Atom, Kai’s A‐Grade Sentinel.
At that moment, there was an intense pressure in the air...

Kai reacted without hesitation. His body blurred withSpecter Step, and in the next instant he was standing beside Atom, his hand resting lightly on the Sentinel’s shoulder... "This is Atom," Kai said firmly. "I’m the owner of this Sentinel."
He remembered Hale Libra, the Augmented Human he had encountered before... He was Level 80 with five Titles, a man who had fought against Ascendant Units of the A.I. Civilization.
Hale had been kind, respectful to fellow humans, and never a threat. Kai could only hope this man was cut from the same cloth.
The man smiled faintly as he relaxed his body.
"I’m not going to destroy it. Don’t worry. I saw that thing fight alongside you." He said with a calm assurance, almost casual, despite the devastation he had just caused.
Kai’s eyes narrowed slightly as he wanted to know why this person was even here...
The mysterious Augment Human had then continued,
"I’m Cornelio Aries from Cameron..." He paused for a moment as he saw their expression...
He then realized something, and repeated his instroduction.
"Ahem... So you don’t know Cameron, right? It’s a Human City in the north. I’m here to invite you to visit the city."
Kai blinked, stunned.
’Cameron?’
He knew the existence of human cities from the map he had purchased, but this was the first time he had heard one named directly. The existence of Cameron meant more than just a dot on parchment...
’I knew it... My map isn’t outdated. There are really human cities out there!’Kai thought but as expected.
"Cameron..." Kai muttered, his voice low. "Wait, why are you inviting me? Am I the only one invited?"

Of course, Kai had been planning to go north eventually. The map had shown him the scattered remnants of human civilization, and he knew he would need to connect with them. But the Global Event had kept piling up, dragging him into endless battles and responsibilities.
Cornelio’s smile widened slightly. "Only Level 30 or someone of similar strength can be invited there. I just passed by and saw that you fit the criteria. If you want to visit the city... use this."
There was no way Kai would believe that reasoning at face value. There must be something else since this was simply too sudden.
In any case, Cornelio reached into his belt and produced a small token made of wood.
Cornelio handed it to Kai without hesitation.
"Hmm?"
Kai accepted it carefully. It felt heavier than it looked, as if it carried more than just physical weight.
Of course, he immediately activated his skill...Fast Appraisal.
[ You have discovered Invitation Token! ]
[ Grade: Special Item ]

[ Description: A token issued by the Human City "Cameron." It serves as proof of qualification and grants entry to the city. Recognized by Augmented Humans, Cameron’s guardians, and the Aries Faction. ]
[ Note: Requirement - Level 30 or equivalent strength. Without meeting this condition, entry will be denied. ]
Kai’s eyes widened as the information appeared before him.
He was telling the truth. This wasn’t just a trinket. It was proof of legitimacy, a key to one of the human strongholds fighting against the A.I. Civilization.
Needless to say, the survivors behind him heard their conversation and could help but imagine themselves entering the place...
"A human city... Cameron..."
"I wish to go there someday."
"M-maybe my family is in that city..."
"Wait. Level 30? T-that’s a bit too high."
Meanwhile, Kai looked back at Cornelio, still cautious.
"So you’re saying I can enter Cameron with this? That they’ll recognize me? Will I become part of your faction or something if I use this token?"

Cornelio smiled and nodded. "Well, yes. You’ll be tied to Aries... Still, it wouldn’t mean that you’re part of our faction already. You’ll only be truly part of us if you gain that surname. Anyway, Cameron doesn’t open its gates to just anyone. But with this, you’ll be welcomed. That’s the most important thing..."
Kai gently nodded...
The possibility of connecting with a larger human city was within reach.
But it also raised questions.
Cornelio seemed to sense his hesitation. However, he didn’t have to explain more.
He knew that this would be extremely hard to reject.
And as expected, Kai tightened his grip on the token and nodded.
He had always known the path ahead would lead him to the human cities. But hearing it directly from an Augmented Human made it real.
He exhaled slowly, nodding once.
"I understand. Thank you... Cornelio Aries."
Cornelio’s smile widened as he heard this...
However, as expected, Cornelio couldn’t contain his curiosity and asked a question that Hale Libra had also asked before!
"Have you been chosen? Ahem... I mean, can you share you Titles with me?"
Kai froze as he heard the same question again.
Previously, Hale said he was searching for someone with a title connected to being chosen by the A.I. Civilization, or perhaps by some A.I. superpower...
Kai smiled as he immediately had an idea. For now, he decided to act as if this was the first time he had heard such a question.
Needless to say, this move allowed him to control the conversation and lead Cornelio into revealing his own Titles, in exchange for Kai’s information.
"Fine... I’ll show mine. Watch." Cornelio said as he took out his own Status Crystal and showed his status to Kai.
[ Name: Cornelio Aries ]
[ Title: Veteran, Conqueror, Anima’s Target, Aria’s Enemy. ]
[ Level: 80 ]

chapters.title: Chapter 208: The Skills, The Storage, and The Faction
paragraphs: "Anima’s Target and Aria’s Enemy? Man... You’re a wanted person by the A.I. Civilization," Kai muttered as he saw the status of the man.
[ Name: Cornelio Aries ]
[ Title: Veteran, Conqueror, Anima’s Target, Aria’s Enemy. ]
[ Level: 80 ]
[ Active Skills: Stonebreaker Impact Lv4, Shockwave Slash Lv3, Momentum Crash Lv5 ]
[ Passive Skills: Hardened Spirit Lv6, Precision Hands Lv5, Indomitable Will Lv7 ]

"Haha... You’ll earn this Title if you keep attacking them. It took me a few years to get these two... Really helpful. Also, you have to know that, unlike Foreign Survivors like you, our ability to obtain Title and Gene Skill is a lot harder... Maybe even ten times harder than..." Cornelio paused for a moment to confirm Kai’s reaction before he added.

"It’s the same for Leveling Up. We need more experience points as well. I really hope you can all reach Level 30 and help Cameron... Even if you don’t join our Faction, that’s fine. As long as you’re part of the allied forces."
Hearing this, Kai finally felt satisfied.
"I understand. Since you showed sincerity, I’ll tell you my titles. They’re called Survivor, Trailblazer, Siege Breaker, Guardian, and Strongest One."
Cornelio paused for a moment after hearing the Titles.
As expected, they weren’t the ones he was looking for.
"I see... Thank you for letting me know." He muttered.

Of course, Kai wouldn’t let him go just yet. He still had many questions. Like what he’d expect in the Human City... or what was he doing here in the first place? Perhaps, he could also ask where to obtain more B-Grade Cores, or maybe areas that they could use to farm more Experience Points, or notable places that might be helpful for their growth.
And just like that, Kai gathered his courage and started asking questions.
Cornelio smiled at this. He knew that he couldn’t answer all his questions, but it shouldn’t be bad to share a little information.

"Cameron isn’t just another settlement. It’s one of the few organized Human Cities still standing against the A.I. Civilization. We’ve built walls reinforced with special alloys, and our defenses are powered by cores we’ve taken from fallen machines. Every day, we fight to keep the city alive."
Kai listened intently...

Cornelio continued... "Inside Cameron, you’ll find factions... Groups of Augmented Humans and Survivors working together. The Aries Faction is one of them, but there are others. We don’t always agree, but when Anima sends its armies, we always stand united. That’s why strength matters. Titles, skills, levels... they aren’t just for show..."
The survivors behind Kai exchanged glances. They couldn’t believe what they had just heard.

Cornelio’s gaze swept over them before returning to Kai. "Resources are scarce. For B‐Grade Cores? You’ll need to be Level 50 at the very least to get a chance against them... The gap between a C-Grade Soldier to B-Grade Soldier is a huge chasm. The most you can do to get their cores is during trade. If you collect those special Survivor Medals, many people in the city would be willing to trade them."
Of course, Cornelio didn’t mention many things to Kai. He decided to keep quiet about the Aries’ Faction’s designated zones, where weaker machines spawn and other stuff.
Kai nodded slowly, absorbing every word.
After a few moments, Kai also bravely asked about Cornelio’s skills.
Apparently, he wanted to learn them as well if possible.
Cornelio laughed. Of course, this time, Cornelio asked for a payment. This wasn’t something he should be sharing in public.
"If I have what you need, I’ll do my best." Kai replied.
"Nice... So if you can supply me with thirty of those Disruptor Devices you’re using against the drones and swarmers, then I’ll brief you about my skills and give you hints on how to get them."
Cornelio was indeed interested in Kai’s Portable Disruptor Field...
"I can arrange that..." Kai replied without hesitation.
This time, Cornelio was the one who was stunned. He didn’t expect that Kai would willingly give up those precious devices.
He was actually prepared to negotiate. If Kai could only provide 15 or even 10 of them, he wouldn’t really mind.
"Ohh... O-okay, then..." Cornelio muttered.
Just like that, Kai learned that Stonebreaker Impact focuses his strength into a single throw or strike, generating crushing force.
It was the one used by Cornelio to destroy the three flying vessels moments ago.
The Shockwave Slash creates a concussive blast upon impact. It wasn’t deadly, but it could affect a wide range.
After that was Momentum Crash. It was very straightforward. The skill would help him charge forward with unstoppable force...
Then, there were his passive skills. The Hardened Frame was basically a defensive Gene Skill that granted him high durability against blunt force and explosions.

The Precision Hand, on the other hand, complements his Stonebreaker Impact since, aside from dexterity it could provide, it enhances accuracy and control, ensuring projectiles land exactly where intended.
Finally, the Indomitable Will that extends stamina and mental resilience, allowing him to fight longer without fatigue or fear.

"Most of my Gene Skills were obtained through my consumption of Gene Enhancement Serum... However, the Idomitable Will was something I got through a traumatic experience. You don’t want to experience that." Cornelio said with a calm smile on his.
Kai bowed his head slightly...
"Thank you, Sir Cornelio. Your honesty and the knowledge you’ve shared mean a lot. I’ll prepare the units you asked for. Please wait a little while."
Cornelio nodded. "Alright... I’ll wait here."
Kai hesitated for a moment before asking, "Uhmmm... I’ll prepare them in the warehouse, but how will you carry them?"
Cornelio smirked and raised his hand.
In his palm appeared a silver‐like box.
"Ahh..." Kai didn’t have to ask. He knew that it had a vast inner space far larger than its exterior.
"This is a storage box. Don’t worry, it can hold more than enough." Cornelio replied.
Just like that, the transaction was easily completed.
As he prepared to leave, Cornelio’s expression grew serious.
"One last thing, Kai. When you reach Cameron, avoid the Virgo Faction at all costs..."

Civilization," Kai muttered as he saw the status of the man.

Civilization.

chapters.title: Chapter 209: The Notification
paragraphs: Kai tilted his head in confusion before repeating his words.
"The Virgo Faction? What about them?"

Cornelio’s earlier statement echoed in his mind. He had said that as long as Survivors reached Level 30 and joined any faction or became part of the allied forces, it would be fine. But now, he was singling out one faction in particular.
Cornelio hesitated and his expression darkened.
He then took a deep breath before answering.

"The Virgo Faction... they’re not like the others. On the surface, they fight against Anima just as we do. They recruit Survivors, they build defenses, they even contribute to the allied forces. But the truth is, they’ve gone too far with their Gene Enhancements. Their obsession with power has pushed them beyond the limits of humanity."
Kai frowned, listening carefully.
Cornelio continued...

"Most factions use Gene Enhancement Serums sparingly, balancing strength with the risk of losing control. But Virgo? They embrace extreme body modification. They alter themselves until they’re barely recognizable as human. Their soldiers are covered in grafted armor plates, they could have added limbs, even monstrous-like body parts..."
He couldn’t help but sigh while recalling something.
"Some even replace their organs with synthetic cores. They call it evolution... but to me, it’s mutilation."
The survivors behind Kai shifted uneasily as they started whispering among themselves.
Cornelio’s gaze hardened.

"I’ve seen their warriors... Many of them had four arms grafted onto their bodies, each capable of wielding a weapon. Another squad had eyes replaced with mechanical lenses... And no, these aren’t just replacing human parts, even those perfectly working body parts would be removed. If you’re under their Faction, even your body might not be yours anymore."
"I will keep that in mind, Sir Cornelio." Kai muttered. To be honest, he couldn’t really blame the Virgo Faction. After all, the world had already changed after the Anima Civilization took over.
If the only sure-fire method to eliminate the higher-ranking A.I. Units was the modification, then it wouldn’t be surprising if many people would just follow this Faction.
This would be especially true if the modification expenses were covered by the Faction as well.

"Once again, don’t abandon your humanity just yet. You can become strong quickly with the permanent modifications... but they’ve sacrificed everything for it. Your growth potential will also be limited. And once you lose your identity as a human, just what separates you from the machines we’re fighting?"
Kai’s grip tightened on the token. He understood now why Cornelio’s warning carried such weight.
Still, he wasn’t against the Body Modifications at all. After all, it could be very useful for the Survivors who had lost their limbs or got injured while fighting the Army.
"I guess you really don’t like their principles, huh..." Kai muttered as Cornelio continued badmouthing the Faction.
Cornelio sighed and nodded.

"Virgo claims their methods are necessary to survive. They say the A.I. Civilization will eventually overwhelm us unless we adapt. But their path leads to ruin... Their soldiers are could become unstable and their minds fractured. Some have turned violent against their own allies. And worst of all, they don’t care. As long as they gain strength, they’ll keep pushing further, no matter the cost."
Kai exhaled slowly, his thoughts racing.
Cornelio’s voice softened, but his words were firm. "If you join Virgo, you’ll be dragged into their madness. This is my advice for your sake, and for the sake of your people."
Kai nodded firmly. "Understood. I’ll remember your warning."
Cornelio’s expression eased slightly, though the seriousness in his eyes remained.
"Good. Then I’ll see you in Cameron. And when you arrive, you’ll understand why this warning matters."
With that, Cornelio turned away, leaving Kai and the survivors with both a gift and a caution that could shape their future.
Soon, the fifth day finally arrived, marking the last date of the Global Event.
From the moment dawn broke, the Freedom Shelter was swarmed.
Whom~
Drones buzzed overhead with their scanners flashing red as they searched for openings of their building...
Swarmers, the insect‐like flying machines, poured in from every direction, breaking and cutting through their barricade...
Thankfully, the Portable Disruptor Field Devices Kai had prepared were effective.
Each device emitted a pulse that scrambled the drones’ signals, preventing many of them from calling for reinforcements and disrupting their movements, essentially making them easy targets...
Soon, the Survivors stopped hiding!
"Hold steady! This is the last day. We can win this!"
For days, he had restricted the use of their heavier weapons since he was avoiding unnecessary risks. But now, with the final assault upon them, he finally gave the order.
"Deploy the grenade launchers!"
The survivors cheered as the long‐awaited weapons were brought forward.
The grenade launchers, part of Kai’s Weapon Gift pack, were equipped with smoke rounds and fragmentation rounds.
The smoke rounds were immediately put to use, blanketing the battlefield in thick cover that disrupted the drones’ targeting systems.
The fragmentation rounds, however, were withheld. Kai knew they were too dangerous against flying enemies, the shrapnel could easily ricochet and harm his own people.
Still, it didn’t take long before they were put to use as Hounds started coming from all directions!
The battle raged on, and then the ground trembled as new enemies arrived.
Hunter Units emerged from the smoke...
They still had bladed hands and two mechanical tentacles on their backs...
"Grenade launchers! Target the Hunters!" Kai shouted...
The survivors obeyed instantly. Smoke rounds burst around the Hunters, disorienting them, while fragmentation grenades followed, detonating with thunderous force!
Boom! Boom! Boom!
The explosions tore through their armored frames, shredding their tentacles and destabilizing their balance.
One by one, the Hunters collapsed, their mechanical shrieks drowned out by the roar of battle.
Just like that, on the final day of the event, numerous Drones, Hounds, Swarmers, and Hunter Units came to attack their shelter.
Thankfully, there were no longer Dominion or Impulse Ships being deployed...
"Use everything! Destroy them all!"
Several hours passed, and soon, the notification that everyone was waiting for finally arrived.
[ Congratulations! You have endured and survived the Global Event: Surveillance Sweep! ]

chapters.title: Chapter 211: The Gene Weapon
paragraphs: [ Kai: Guys... Anyone got the Blueprint Fragment for the Advanced Barrier System Generator? ]
Kai didn’t have to wait long before seeing a reply since a chat coming from the Guild Leader would notify the members.
[ Claire: I have 1 fragment, Leader. Just checked, and looks like we need 10 pieces to complete it. ]
[ Wallace: Haha, lucky me. I got 2 fragments and even 2 Core Parts. Guess the System likes me today. ]
[ Victor: I’ve got 1 fragment too. I also have some crafting materials that might help build one. ]
[ Ralph: I don’t have any fragments... Sorry. No crafting materials related to that barrier as well. But I have a lot of Medals now! ]
[ Elena: Ugh... You’re not alone. No fragments for me. Just a bunch of Gift Packs. At least they’re Enhanced ones. ]
[ Marissa: I checked mine... I’ve got 1 fragment... ]
[ Jonas: Leader, I got 2 fragments and a Barrier Core Stabilizer. That should help when we assemble it. ]
[ Aurora: I also have 1 fragment. Didn’t expect it, but I’m glad. ]
[ Farrah: Sorry, none here. Just Survivor’s Medals and other stuff. I wish to trade them later for Grenade Launcher’s smoke and fragmentation rounds. ]
[ Alfie: I’ve got 1 fragment... and about 20 C-Grade Cores. I plan to trade them for later. I need more ammunition and those thruster packs. It was useful against the Dominion.
[ Mei: Same here, just 1 fragment... @Alfie. The Thruster Pack is awesome! But we didn’t get to use them here. ]
Kai smiled after seeing this.
He didn’t hurry to obtain these fragments, but he told them to take care of them for now.
After that, Kai checked the other notifications.
This time, it was all about Guild Notifications about them completing various Guild Missions.
Apparently, the Supply Run Mission was completed a total of five times.
[ Mission 1: Supply Run ]
Difficulty: Low
Objective: Submit 100 units of food to the Guild Storage within 30 hours.
Reward: Guild Reputation +50, Energy Core (C-Grade) x5 ]
Then, after the fifth time, the mission had changed.
The difficulty had actually increased!
[ Mission 1: Great Supply Run ]
Difficulty: Mid
Objective: Submit 500 units of food to the Guild Storage within 48 hours.
Reward: Guild Reputation +50, Energy Core (C-Grade) x10, Survivor Medals x5 ]
It was definitely a lot harder to complete without his help since he was the only one who could produce unlimited Food Gift Packs.
Furthermore, the second mission was the same.
It had been completed five times before it was changed to a different or harder mission.
[ Mission 2: Patrol Elimination ]
[ Difficulty: Mid
Objective: Eliminate 1 C-Grade Unit, 5 D-Grade Units and 10 E-Grade Units of the A.I. Army. ]
Reward: Guild Reputation +75, Energy Core (C-Grade) x2, Passive Buff +5% stamina recovery to all Clan Members for 24 hours. ]
As for the third mission, there was no way to complete it yet because he needed 3 more Foreign Survivors to invite.
Kai closed the notifications for now, letting the glowing text fade from his vision.
There was still work to be done, so he joined the others in assisting with the looting and hauling of the Hunters and other units.
Not far from the shelter, they had created what resembled a graveyard... or perhaps more accurately, a junkyard.
It was where they piled the A.I. Soldiers and units that were too heavily damaged or too difficult to dismantle for spare parts. Their fate would most likely to be melted in a furnace.
Their metals could be converted into barricades, formed to forge traps, or repurposed for defensive structures.
As for those with intact components, they were carefully carried to the warehouse.
Survivors worked tirelessly as they stripped plating and salvaged the cores inside.
Soon, even the traps were reset, and the barricades were reinforced with fresh layers of steel.
By the time the last body of Hound was dragged into place, darkness had already fallen. And of course, the generators were already on, giving light within the building.
"Good work, everyone! We can all finally rest..." Kai said.
Everyone cheered as they returned to their quarters to rest.
Meanwhile, Kai and the others could now focus on the items they had obtained.
"Let’s see..." Kai muttered as he checked his inventory.
His attention fell on the Gene Weapon.
As expected, it was still in cube form with restrained energy.
He held it in his palm, and it was truly heavy, comparable to the low-grade Gene Weapons.
The cube just looked normal, but it was cold to the touch...
"So this is the Specter Edge..." he muttered.
He could not sense the dormant power within, but he knew that it was the real deal when he got the notification.
[ You have obtained a Dormant Gene Weapon. ]
[ Do you wish to awaken it and become its owner? ]
There was only one answer.
"Yes." Kai answered.
[ Activating Gene Weapon - Specter Edge ]
[ Connection in progress... ]
[ Synchronizing Spirit Resonance... ]
[ Warning: Gene Weapon requires a compatible Spirit Flow. ]
[ Compatibility Check: Passed. ]
[ Awakening Sequence Initiated. ]
A low hum filled the air as gears inside the cube began to shift.
Kai’s grip tightened, and the panels unfolded slowly... Soon, thin lines of light spilled out...
The cube then elongated, reshaping itself into a weapon.
Slowly, its true form emerged... a dagger that was lustrous and black!
[ Gene Weapon Awakened: Specter Edge ]
[ Grade: Mid ]
[ Type: Spirit‐Infused Dagger ]
[ Effects: +15% Armor Penetration against mechanical units.
Signal Disruption: Attacks have a chance to disable enemy sensors. ]
[ Hidden Attribute: ??? (Requires further appraisal) ]
Hu~
Kai exhaled. He felt really excited now.

At first glance, it looked like any ordinary dagger, but the System’s notifications told him otherwise. This was no simple blade... it was a weapon designed to cut through armor and disrupt the A.I.’s signal nodes.
He raised it, feeling the weight settle naturally in his hand.
"This... this is perfect," Kai muttered... "Not flashy, but deadly. Exactly what we need."
Now, he couldn’t help but recall Angelo’s shelter.
’I guess it’s time to make a visit..’
